top_signals.title: Russian Cargo Ship Attacked By Drones in Gulf of Finland
top_signals.summary: Russia said a cargo ship bound for its Kaliningrad exclave was targeted in international waters in the Gulf of Finland, highlighting growing risks to the country’s energy and food exports through critical Baltic Sea shipping routes.
